audit_events_actor.name: audit_events_actor
audit_events_actor.value:
"app"."audit_events"."actor_kind" in ('user', 'support', 'system')
          and (
            ("app"."audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "app"."audit_events"."actor_id" is null)
            or ("app"."audit_events"."actor_kind" in ('user', 'support') and "app"."audit_events"."actor_id" is not null)
          )

audit_events_target_ids.name: audit_events_target_ids
audit_events_target_ids.value:
CASE
  WHEN cardinality("app"."audit_events"."target_ids") = 0 THEN true
  WHEN array_ndims("app"."audit_events"."target_ids") IS DISTINCT FROM 1 THEN false
  ELSE array_position("app"."audit_events"."target_ids", NULL) IS NULL
END

persons_name_split.name: persons_name_split
persons_name_split.value:
(
            "app"."persons"."is_minor" = true
            and "app"."persons"."household_id" is not null
            and "app"."persons"."given_name" is null
            and "app"."persons"."family_name" is null
            and "app"."persons"."given_name_restricted" is not null
            and "app"."persons"."family_name_restricted" is not null
          ) or (
            "app"."persons"."is_minor" = false
            and "app"."persons"."given_name" is not null
            and "app"."persons"."family_name" is not null
            and "app"."persons"."given_name_restricted" is null
            and "app"."persons"."family_name_restricted" is null
          )

persons_birthday_md_range.name: persons_birthday_md_range
persons_birthday_md_range.value: "app"."persons"."birthday_md" is null or ("app"."persons"."birthday_md" / 100 between 1 and 12 and "app"."persons"."birthday_md" % 100 between 1 and 31)
